SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers

WITH Consumption2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinConsumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinTotal
    FROM Consumption2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
LowestConsumers AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.TotalConsumption) AS TotalConsumption,
           COUNT(*) AS NumCustomers
    FROM Consumption2013 AS t
    JOIN MinConsumption AS m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinTotal
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
SegmentAverages AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           TotalConsumption / NumCustomers AS AvgConsumption
    FROM LowestConsumers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element || '-' || a2.element = (
    SELECT a1.element || '-' || a2.element
    FROM connected c2
    JOIN atom a1 ON c2.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c2.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, ct.total_consumption
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN min_seg ms
      ON ct.Segment = ms.Segment
     AND ct.total_consumption = ms.min_consumption
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest_customers

    / SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', loan.date) = '1996' THEN loan.amount END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan
JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id

        WHEN 'A' THEN 'contract finished, no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'contract finished, loan not paid'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'contract running, OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'contract running, client in debt'
    END AS payment_status,
    MAX(0, l.amount - l.payments * MIN(
        (CAST(strftime('%Y', date('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER)) * 12 +
        (CAST(strftime('%m', date('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%m', l.date) AS INTEGER)),

WITH per_customer AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per CZK customer, grouped by segment
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest consumption in each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of lowest-consumption customer(s) / count of them
    SELECT pc.Segment,
           SUM(pc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(pc.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM per_customer pc
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON pc.Segment = m.Segment AND pc.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY pc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

);

SELECT l.Date,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER)
         - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_first_arrival
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T1.`aCL IgM`
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T1.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS num_female_patients,
       GROUP_CONCAT(ID) AS patient_ids
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT 
    SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' 
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T1.Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'
  AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT CAST(julianday(MIN(Examination.`Examination Date`)) - julianday(Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS DaysBeforeEvaluation
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT Laboratory.ID, Laboratory.TP, Laboratory.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Patient.ID IN (
      SELECT Laboratory.ID
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5
  )
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS "Albumin within normal range"
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(l.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.Date = (
    SELECT MAX(l2.Date)
    FROM Laboratory l2
    WHERE l2.ID = l.ID
)
AND (
    (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0)
    OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5)
);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND T2.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(P.SEX = 'M') > SUM(P.SEX = 'F') AS result
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT L.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Examination.ID)

  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' 
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID

JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Examination.ID) 
FROM Examination 
JOIN Laboratory ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Examination.Diagnosis = 'APS' 
  AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SM IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) 
FROM Patient p 
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID 
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID 
WHERE l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') 
  AND p.SEX = 'F' 
  AND e.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN T1.ID END) * 1.0 / COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60

SELECT T1.`First Date`
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH < 500
ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T2.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1

  AND T1.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT Diagnosis

    SELECT ID

    ORDER BY TG DESC 
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond

ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT
    CAST((SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM bond b
          JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
          WHERE m.label = '+'
            AND b.bond_type = '-') AS REAL)
    /
    (SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id)
     FROM atom a
     JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
     WHERE m.label = '+') AS avg_single_bonds_per_atom;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN A.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(A.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS A
WHERE A.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT B.molecule_id
    FROM bond AS B
    WHERE B.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'

LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE 
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
           ELSE 'Non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id  FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT a1.atom_id, a1.element, a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN atom b ON b.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
JOIN atom b ON b.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE b.element = 'pb';

WITH combos AS (
    SELECT a1.element AS elem1,
           a2.element AS elem2,
           COUNT(*)   AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM combos;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS result
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ( (a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
     OR (a1.element = 'c'  AND a2.element = 'cl') );

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE 
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' 
           ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' 
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(a.element) AS tally, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca'

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' 
  AND T3.atom_id = 'TR000_1'

SELECT DISTINCT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM bond
     WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
       AND bond_type = ' = ') AS num_double_bonds,
    (SELECT label
     FROM molecule
     WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006') AS carcinogenic;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id) AS num_bonds
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl'
  AND T3.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*)

WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id

    )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id

    );

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id

SELECT molecule_id

SELECT

        WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id

JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id

SELECT molecule.molecule_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)

JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
minima AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN minima m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        THEN 'In-patient' 
        ELSE 'Outpatient' 
    END AS More_Frequent,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Deviation_Percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT Patient.ID, YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.RVVT = '+';
SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT T2.Date, (strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC, T2.Date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND YEAR(Birthday) = 1964
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2 
  AND T2.ANA = 'S' 
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE SEX = 'M' 
  AND Diagnosis = 'Behcet' 
  AND Admission = '-' 
  AND ID IN (
      SELECT ID 
      FROM Examination 
      WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  );

SELECT DATEDIFF(`Examination Date`, `First Date`)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT P.ID, CASE WHEN L.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT Patient.ID, Laboratory.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID,
       p.Birthday,
       l.ALB,
       CASE 
           WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
           ELSE 'Out of normal range'
       END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE YEAR(p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS avg_ua_index
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date = (
    SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
    FROM Laboratory L2
    WHERE L2.ID = L.ID
)
AND (
    (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
    OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5)
);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(P.SEX = 'M') > SUM(P.SEX = 'F') AS answer
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `T-BIL` >= 2.0
)
GROUP BY SEX;

SELECT p.ID, l.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) < 70

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T3.Thrombosis = 2 AND T2.C4 > 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND YEAR(T1.`First Date`) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) 
   FROM Laboratory 
   JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID 
   WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE') * 1.0 
  / 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) 
   FROM Laboratory 
   WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60) AS percentage;
SELECT MAX(T2.Birthday) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.GOT >= 60

SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH = (
    SELECT MAX(LDH)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE LDH < 500
);
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT ID
FROM Examination
WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE CRE < 1.5)
ORDER BY `aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM connected
JOIN atom ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id OR atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2
WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT bond.bond_type, connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN (SELECT label 
               FROM molecule 
               WHERE molecule_id = (
                   SELECT molecule_id
                   FROM bond
                   WHERE bond_type = ' = '
                   GROUP BY molecule_id
                   ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
                   LIMIT 1
               )) = '+' 
         THEN 'yes' 
         ELSE 'no' 
       END AS is_carcinogenic;

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT a1.atom_id, a1.element, a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT T2.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT COUNT(T1.bond_id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected) AS percentage
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
GROUP BY T2.element, T3.element
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'c')
    OR (T2.element = 'c' AND T3.element = 'cl'))

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
            ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM atom a 
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 's'
)
AND molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
);

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT T2.molecule_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T1.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` 
FROM frpm AS T1 
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T2.`SOCType` = 'Continuation School' 
ORDER BY `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` ASC 
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND s.Magnet = 1;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CDSCode
FROM frpm
WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" + "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500

SELECT T1.dname
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T1.dname
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT satscores.AvgScrWrite, schools.CharterNum,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(t.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT s.School,
       s.Street,
       s.City,
       s.State,
       s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800
  AND s.County = 'Monterey';

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
  );

SELECT "Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / "Enrollment (K-12)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS average_test_takers
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno'
  AND strftime('%Y', sc.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31'
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.MailStreet, T2.School
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores T1
JOIN schools T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.MailCity = 'Lakeport'
  AND T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrWrite >= 1500

SELECT website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(*)

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_cons
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_cons) AS min_cons
    FROM czk
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT cz.Segment, SUM(cz.total_cons) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk cz
    JOIN mins m ON cz.Segment = m.Segment AND cz.total_cons = m.min_cons
    GROUP BY cz.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff;

    M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10,

)

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount AS loan_amount,
    l.duration,
    l.payments AS monthly_payment,
    l.status,
    COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS paid_so_far,
    l.amount - COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS remaining_debt,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Loan finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Loan finished - debt unpaid'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Loan running - payments OK'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Loan running - indebted (late on payments)'
    END AS payment_status
FROM client c
JOIN disp d
    ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN loan l
    ON l.account_id = d.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans t
    ON t.account_id = l.account_id
   AND t.k_symbol = 'UVER'
   AND t.date >= l.date
WHERE c.client_id = 992
GROUP BY c.client_id, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status;

WITH czk_lowest AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND ym.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth)
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           SUM(Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    e.event_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense ex
    ON ex.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN attendance a
    ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN event e
    ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE ex.approved = 'true'
  AND ex.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT DISTINCT m.email
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
  AND e.cost > 20;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE ma.major_name = 'education'
  AND ma.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY MAX(e.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.phone
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);
SELECT T1.major_name, T1.department FROM major AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major WHERE T2.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T2.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, mj.college
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent, e.event_name
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;
SELECT T1.city FROM zip_code AS T1 JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.zip_code = T2.zip WHERE T2.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T2.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
GROUP BY s.id, s.full_name
HAVING COUNT(s.full_name) > 15;
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE eye_colour_id = (SELECT id FROM colour WHERE colour = 'Blue');

SELECT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY superhero.height_cm DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id 
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(s.id)) AS percentage,
       SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_comics_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;
SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg)
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Alien';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'Human';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(id) * 1.0 / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT superhero.height_cm FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT DISTINCT c2.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(id) AS average_height
FROM superhero;
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND s.superhero_name = 'Hulk';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm)
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral';

SELECT T1.hero_id
FROM hero_power AS T1
INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT T2.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T3 ON T1.id = T3.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T3.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN 'In-patient'
        ELSE 'Outpatient'
    END AS More_Group,
    ROUND(
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0
        / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    , 2) AS Deviation_Percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT T1.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT T1.Date, 
       strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday))
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS num_patients, ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
ORDER BY Symptoms DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT CAST(JULIANDAY(`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(`First Date`) AS INTEGER)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT l.TP - 8.5 AS TP_deviation
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND (l.ALB <= 3.5 OR l.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC;

SELECT T1.ID,
       T2.ALB,
       CASE WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
            ELSE 'Not within normal range' END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(UA)
FROM (
    SELECT L.ID, L.UA, P.SEX,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY L.ID ORDER BY L.Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory L
    JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
) T
WHERE rn = 1
  AND ((SEX = 'M' AND UA < 8.0) OR (SEX = 'F' AND UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT Patient.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) AS Patients
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L."T-CHO"
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
ORDER BY L."T-CHO" DESC, P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN T2.ID END) AS REAL) * 1.0 / COUNT(T2.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH < 500
GROUP BY T1.ID
ORDER BY MAX(T2.LDH) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA)
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE < 1.5
  AND e."aCL IgA" = (
      SELECT MAX(e2."aCL IgA")
      FROM Examination e2
      JOIN Laboratory l2 ON e2.ID = l2.ID
      WHERE l2.CRE < 1.5
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1."T-BIL" >= 2.0
  AND T2."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS average
FROM bond AS b
INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
INNER JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND bond.bond_type = '-'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) top ON m.molecule_id = top.molecule_id;

SELECT element 
FROM atom 
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected) 
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT a1.atom_id, a1.element, a2.atom_id AS atom_id2, a2.element AS element2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected) AS percentage
FROM connected AS c1
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c1.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c1.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element || ',' || a2.element = (
    SELECT a1.element || ',' || a2.element
    FROM connected AS c2
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON c2.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON c2.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id),
    5
) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END
FROM connected AS c

WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, y.Consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
minseg AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_c
  FROM base
  GROUP BY Segment
),
avgseg AS (
  SELECT b.Segment, SUM(b.Consumption) / COUNT(b.CustomerID) AS avg_c
  FROM base b
  JOIN minseg m ON b.Segment = m.Segment AND b.Consumption = m.min_c
  GROUP BY b.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avg_c FROM avgseg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_c FROM avgseg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
  (SELECT avg_c FROM avgseg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_c FROM avgseg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  (SELECT avg_c FROM avgseg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_c FROM avgseg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME
