SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.height_cm = 185 AND r.race = 'human'
SELECT T2.power_name FROM hero_power AS T1 INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id WHERE T1.hero_id = 1

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(id) * 1.0 / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
SELECT T1.height_cm FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber'

SELECT eye_colour.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour AS skin_colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = skin_colour.id
JOIN colour AS eye_colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = eye_colour.id
WHERE skin_colour.colour = 'Gold'
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE race_id = (SELECT id FROM race WHERE race = 'Vampire')

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM superhero INNER JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
SELECT (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') - (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS weight_difference;
SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) FROM superhero;
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg = 0 OR weight_kg IS NULL;
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan'
SELECT publisher.publisher_name FROM superhero JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE superhero.id = 38

SELECT a.alignment, s.power_name
FROM superhero sh
JOIN alignment a ON sh.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = sh.id
JOIN superpower s ON s.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sh.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';
SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race FROM superhero JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id = 2;
SELECT ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id INNER JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_attribute JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ORDER BY attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';
SELECT T1.full_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Brown' AND T1.weight_kg < 100
SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE s.id = 40
SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral'
SELECT T1.hero_id FROM hero_power AS T1 JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id WHERE T2.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.power_name
FROM superpower AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.power_id
JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T2.hero_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'In-patient' ELSE 'Outpatient' END, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'

SELECT P.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.RVVT = '+';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T2.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.ALB < 3.5
SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG >= 200)
SELECT T2.Date, T1.`First Date` - T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS' ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;
SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30');
SELECT T2."aCL IgM" FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T2."Examination Date" = '1993/11/12'
SELECT SEX FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE GPT = '9' AND Date = '1992-06-12');
SELECT strftime('%Y', t.Date) - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) FROM Laboratory t JOIN Patient p ON t.ID = p.ID WHERE t.UA = '8.4' AND t.Date = '1991-10-21'
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2 AND T2.ANA = 'S' AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS' AND T3.CRP > 2 AND T3.CRE = 1 AND T3.LDH = 123
SELECT MAX(Symptoms) FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'RA' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'Behcet' AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'

SELECT JULIANDAY(MIN(E.`Examination Date`)) - JULIANDAY(P.`First Date`) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500
SELECT Patient.ID, Laboratory.ALP < 300 FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Birthday = '1982-04-01'
SELECT T2.TP - 8.5 FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.TP > 8.5
SELECT * FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB <= 3.5 OR ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY Birthday DESC;
SELECT p.ID, CASE WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALB_Normal_Range FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982'

SELECT AVG(T1.UA) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Date = (SELECT MAX(Date) FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = T1.ID) AND (T1.UA < 8.0 AND T2.SEX = 'M' OR T1.UA < 6.5 AND T2.SEX = 'F')
SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND L.UN < 30
SELECT SUM(P.SEX = 'M') > SUM(P.SEX = 'F') AS Answer FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5
SELECT SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory."T-BIL" >= 2.0 GROUP BY SEX;
SELECT T1.ID, T1."T-CHO" FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory) ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) FROM Laboratory JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Laboratory.APTT > 45 AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450)
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."U-PRO" >= 30
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory."U-PRO" > 0 AND Laboratory."U-PRO" < 30 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', date('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) FROM Laboratory JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Laboratory.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND Examination.KCT = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20 AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) > 60;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 1 AND T3.C4 > 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID INNER JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Laboratory.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') AND T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.Symptoms IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-','+-') AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN P.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN P.ID END) * 1.0 / COUNT(P.ID) FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500)
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 ORDER BY T3."aCL IgA" DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID WHERE L."T-BIL" >= 2.0 AND E."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%';
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TG < 200 ORDER BY T2.TG DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM atom JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom_id) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=')

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-';
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element LIMIT 3
SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') FROM molecule;
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule;

SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' AND T1.label = '-' ORDER BY T1.molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_id LIMIT 2
SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004';
SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected);
SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2 FROM connected JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND bond.bond_type = '#'

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id2 FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'pb' UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS cnt FROM connected AS c JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2 GROUP BY MIN(a1.element, a2.element), MAX(a1.element, a2.element))

SELECT ROUND(SUM(molecule.label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.element) FROM atom AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '-'
SELECT molecule_id, label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002');
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T3.element) = 2 FROM connected AS T2 JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND T3.element IN ('cl', 'c')
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) FROM molecule JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-'
SELECT b.bond_id, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#';
SELECT count(*), element FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+' AND substr(T1.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
SELECT T1.label FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element = 'ca'
SELECT SUM(bond_type = ' = ') * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+';
SELECT b.molecule_id FROM bond AS b JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND a.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT atom.atom_id FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, m.label
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id) FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl'

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT T3.bond_type) FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T4.molecule_id = T1.molecule_id WHERE T4.label = 'TR346' GROUP BY T1.atom_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');
SELECT m.label FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';
SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'cl' AND molecule.label = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'c'
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';
SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_2' INTERSECT SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_4'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 's' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ' AND a.element = 'o';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation Education'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T1.sname 
FROM satscores AS T1 
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT s.dname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.dname
ORDER BY AVG(s.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.cds)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr < 100
  AND T2.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.StatusType = 'Merged'

SELECT satscores.sname, satscores.AvgScrWrite, schools.CharterNum
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT T3.School, T3.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T3 ON T1.cds = T3.CDSCode
WHERE T3.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T3.School
HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND s.GSserved = '9-12';

SELECT School, DOCType
FROM schools
WHERE FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND CDSCode IN (
      SELECT CDSCode
      FROM frpm
      WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (
          SELECT AVG(`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
          FROM frpm
          WHERE CDSCode IN (
              SELECT CDSCode
              FROM schools
              WHERE FundingType = 'Locally funded'
          )
      )
  );

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Eligible Free Rate (K-12)`
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';
SELECT T2.AdmEmail1 FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr)

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND CAST(y.Date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_by_segment AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m
      ON m.Segment = t.Segment
     AND m.min_consumption = t.total_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_1  FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_2  FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_3  FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_4  FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_5  FROM italy_matches

    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_7  FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_8  FROM italy_matches

WITH CustomerTotals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(CAST(y.Date AS TEXT), 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinPerSegment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM CustomerTotals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
LowestPerSegment AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM CustomerTotals ct
    JOIN MinPerSegment m
      ON m.Segment = ct.Segment AND m.MinConsumption = ct.TotalConsumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END) AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END) AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END) AS Diff_KAM_SME
FROM LowestPerSegment;

FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Match AS T2
  ON T1.player_api_id IN (T2.home_player_1, T2.home_player_2, T2.home_player_3, T2.home_player_4, T2.home_player_5, T2.home_player_6, T2.home_player_7, T2.home_player_8, T2.home_player_9, T2.home_player_10, T2.home_player_11, T2.away_player_1, T2.away_player_2, T2.away_player_3, T2.away_player_4, T2.away_player_5, T2.away_player_6, T2.away_player_7, T2.away_player_8, T2.away_player_9, T2.away_player_10, T2.away_player_11)

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, c.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
JOIN Match m ON pa.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
    m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11

FROM (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match

    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match

FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';
SELECT AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995, AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996, CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_percentage_year FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) 
FROM district d 
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id 
WHERE c.gender = 'F' 
  AND d.A11 > 6000 
  AND d.A11 < 10000;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - di.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND di.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(di2.A11)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN district di2 ON c2.district_id = di2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
          AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  );

JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 1997 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_c
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest AS (
  SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_c) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_c
  FROM totals t
  JOIN (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_c) AS min_c
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
  ) m ON m.Segment = t.Segment AND t.total_c = m.min_c
  GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_c END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_c END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_c END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_c END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_c END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_c END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM lowest;

WITH cust_total AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND CAST(y.Date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_total
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_total ct
    JOIN seg_min sm ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
least_customers AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) AS sum_consumption, COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM totals AS t
    JOIN min_totals AS m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
avg_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, sum_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM least_customers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

        WHERE CustomerID = 38508) AS total_amount_spent,
       (SELECT SUM(T1.Price)
        FROM transactions_1k AS T1
        INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
        WHERE T1.CustomerID = 38508
          AND T2.Date = '201201') AS january_2012_amount_spent;

SELECT t.CustomerID, SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AvgPricePerItem, c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);
SELECT player_name, height FROM Player ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes WHERE potential = (SELECT MIN(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT player_api_id, MAX(crossing) AS max_crossing
FROM Player_Attributes
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY max_crossing DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T.team_long_name, COUNT(*) AS losses
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Match AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.home_team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' AND M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal < 0
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY losses ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
WHERE substr(T1.date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND T1.overall_rating > (
      SELECT AVG(T2.overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes AS T2
      WHERE substr(T2.date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  )
  AND T1.overall_rating = (
      SELECT MAX(T3.overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes AS T3
      WHERE substr(T3.date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  );
SELECT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
    SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T2.team_long_name)
    FROM Team AS T2
    JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA2 ON T2.team_api_id = TA2.team_api_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
      AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT SUM(PA.long_shots) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_long_shots
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT p.player_name, AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) AS avg_heading_accuracy
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00' AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
      SELECT AVG(TA2.chanceCreationPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      WHERE TA2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
        AND TA2.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00' AND TA2.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;
SELECT team_short_name FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'Queens Park Rangers';

FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id

SELECT T2.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (
    M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
    M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
    M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,
    M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name AS country
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.country_id, p.player_api_id
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
        m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
) pc
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pc.player_api_id
JOIN Country c ON c.id = pc.country_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

WITH im AS (
    SELECT m.home_player_1 AS hp1, m.home_player_2 AS hp2, m.home_player_3 AS hp3, m.home_player_4 AS hp4, m.home_player_5 AS hp5, m.home_player_6 AS hp6, m.home_player_7 AS hp7, m.home_player_8 AS hp8, m.home_player_9 AS hp9, m.home_player_10 AS hp10, m.home_player_11 AS hp11,
           m.away_player_1 AS ap1, m.away_player_2 AS ap2, m.away_player_3 AS ap3, m.away_player_4 AS ap4, m.away_player_5 AS ap5, m.away_player_6 AS ap6, m.away_player_7 AS ap7, m.away_player_8 AS ap8, m.away_player_9 AS ap9, m.away_player_10 AS ap10, m.away_player_11 AS ap11
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
),
players AS (
    SELECT hp1 AS pid FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp2 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp3 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp4 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp5 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp6 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp7 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp8 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp9 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp10 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp11 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap1 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap2 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap3 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap4 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap5 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap6 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap7 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap8 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap9 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap10 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap11 FROM im
)
SELECT AVG(p.height) AS avg_height
FROM Player p
JOIN players pl ON p.player_api_id = pl.pid
WHERE pl.pid IS NOT NULL;
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name LIMIT 3
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN stamina > 80 AND strength > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes;

FROM loan

JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id

SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
          AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  );

WHERE l.duration > 12

FROM account a

FROM account

WHERE d.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_female
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN l.date LIKE '1997%' OR l.date LIKE '97%' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN l.date LIKE '1996%' OR l.date LIKE '96%' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN l.date LIKE '1996%' OR l.date LIKE '96%' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 t
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

    SELECT y.CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212

SELECT c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth y

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT cz.Segment,
           SUM(cz.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM czk_2013 cz
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON cz.Segment = m.Segment AND cz.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY cz.Segment
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvg END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvg END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvg END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM annual_avg;

    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        WHEN AVG(A13) > AVG(A12) THEN '1996'
        ELSE 'Equal'
    END AS year_with_higher_unemployment

FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id

  AND d.A11 > 6000

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia'

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district)

LIMIT 1;

      WHERE l2.duration > 12

        AND strftime('%Y', a2.date) = '1993'

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(CAST(l.date AS TEXT), 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(CAST(l.date AS TEXT), 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
   / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(CAST(l.date AS TEXT), 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  AS SME_LAM_Diff,
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  AS LAM_KAM_Diff,
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  AS KAM_SME_Diff;

SELECT

    - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 1996 THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
  ) * 100.0
  / SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 1996 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    l.amount,
    CAST(
      CASE
        WHEN LENGTH(l.date) = 6 THEN '19' || SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2)
        ELSE SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4)
      END AS INTEGER
    ) AS yr
  FROM loan l
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.account_id = l.account_id

  )
) t
WHERE yr IN (1996, 1997);

WITH UserComments AS (
    -- Count comments per user
    SELECT UserId,
           COUNT(Id) AS CommentCount
    FROM comments
    WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY UserId
),
MaxComment AS (
    -- Find the highest comment count
    SELECT MAX(CommentCount) AS MaxCount
    FROM UserComments
)
SELECT u.Id          AS UserId,
       u.DisplayName,
       uc.CommentCount,
       b.Name        AS Badge,
       b.Date        AS BadgeDate
FROM UserComments uc
JOIN MaxComment mc
     ON uc.CommentCount = mc.MaxCount
JOIN users u
     ON u.Id = uc.UserId
LEFT JOIN badges b
     ON b.UserId = u.Id
ORDER BY u.Id, b.Date;

WITH CustomerTotals AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, only CZK-paying customers
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinTotals AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM CustomerTotals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
SegmentAvg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consuming
    -- customer(s) / number of such customers, per segment
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM CustomerTotals ct
    JOIN MinTotals m
      ON ct.Segment = m.Segment
     AND ct.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH player_country AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match WHERE home_player_1  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match WHERE home_player_2  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match WHERE home_player_3  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match WHERE home_player_4  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match WHERE home_player_5  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match WHERE home_player_6  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match WHERE home_player_7  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match WHERE home_player_8  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match WHERE home_player_9  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match WHERE home_player_10 IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match WHERE home_player_11 IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match WHERE away_player_1  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match WHERE away_player_2  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match WHERE away_player_3  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match WHERE away_player_4  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match WHERE away_player_5  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match WHERE away_player_6  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match WHERE away_player_7  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match WHERE away_player_8  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match WHERE away_player_9  IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match WHERE away_player_10 IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match WHERE away_player_11 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT c.name AS country_name
FROM player_country pc
JOIN Country c ON c.id = pc.country_id
JOIN Player  p ON p.player_api_id = pc.player_api_id
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING AVG(p.weight) = (
    SELECT MAX(country_avg_weight)
    FROM (
        SELECT AVG(p2.weight) AS country_avg_weight
        FROM player_country pc2
        JOIN Country c2 ON c2.id = pc2.country_id
        JOIN Player  p2 ON p2.player_api_id = pc2.player_api_id
        GROUP BY c2.name
    ) AS avgs
);

    JOIN Country AS C ON C.id = M.country_id
    WHERE C.name = 'Italy'
),
MatchPlayers AS (
    SELECT home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_2  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_3  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_4  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_5  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_6  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_7  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_8  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_9  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_1  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_2  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_3  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_4  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_5  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_6  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_7  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_8  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_9  FROM ItalianMatches

)

    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - t.A11 AS gap
FROM client c

JOIN district t ON c.district_id = t.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  -- oldest female: smallest birth_date (older person => smaller birth_date)
  AND c.birth_date = (
        SELECT MIN(birth_date)
        FROM client
        WHERE gender = 'F'
  )
  -- among the oldest females, keep only the lowest average salary (A11)
  AND t.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(t2.A11)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN district t2 ON c2.district_id = t2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
          AND c2.birth_date = (

JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2
  ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN superhero.gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero
WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human'
  AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS num_in_patients,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS num_out_patients,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) /
        COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS deviation_ratio
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT T1.ID, 
       CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', MAX(Birthday)) AS INTEGER) 
     - CAST(strftime('%Y', MIN(Birthday)) AS INTEGER) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT T1.Date,
       (strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday)) AS age_at_first_visit
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    -- Numerator: number of (patient, lab) records for males with UA <= 8.0
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
    /
    -- Denominator: number of (patient, lab) records for females with UA <= 6.5
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', Laboratory.Date) BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date = '1992-06-12' AND T2.GPT = '9';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2   -- i.e., AVG * 1.2
      FROM Examination
  );

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', BIRTHDAY) = '1980' 
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND P.Admission = '-'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997';

SELECT CAST(
    julianday(replace(Examination.`Examination Date`, '/', '-')) -
    julianday(replace(Patient.`First Date`, '/', '-'))
    AS INTEGER
) AS days_before_evaluation
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes - within normal range'
        ELSE 'No - above normal range'
    END AS ALP_Normal_Range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.TP > 8.5

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday, P.Description, P.`First Date`, P.Admission, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE
           WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
           ELSE 'No'
       END AS alb_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(t.UA) AS avg_UA
FROM (
    SELECT L.ID,
           L.UA,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY L.ID ORDER BY L.Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory AS L
) AS t
INNER JOIN Patient AS P
    ON P.ID = t.ID
WHERE t.rn = 1
  AND (
        (P.SEX = 'M' AND t.UA < 8.0)
     OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND t.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT DISTINCT 
    Patient.ID, 
    Patient.SEX, 
    Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS Answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    Patient.SEX,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS patient_list
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory 
    ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (
    SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`)
    FROM Laboratory
)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND l.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND l.`U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.IGG > 900 
  AND l.IGG < 2000 
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+'
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1
  AND l.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient."First Date") AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.DNA < 8
  AND P.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Patient.ID END) * 1.0 
       / COUNT(Patient.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(T2.`First Date`) AS FirstRecordedDate
FROM Patient AS T2
WHERE T2.ID = (
    SELECT T1.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS T1
    WHERE T1.LDH < 500
    ORDER BY T1.LDH DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5
  AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(E.ANA) AS highest_ANA
FROM Examination AS E
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T1.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG < 200
    ORDER BY TG DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS chlorine_molecules
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(c.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond.bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT c.atom_id
                        FROM connected c
                        UNION
                        SELECT c.atom_id2
                        FROM connected c);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'pb';

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'c';

SELECT ROUND(
           SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
           / COUNT(b.bond_id),
           5
       ) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE
         WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'yes'
         ELSE 'no'
       END AS result
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ( (a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
     OR (a1.element = 'c'  AND a2.element = 'cl') );

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       m.molecule_id,
       CASE 
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
           WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(a.element) AS element_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'Non-Carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND a.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
    m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS bond_count
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 's'
)
AND molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
);

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT molecule_id
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_2'
INTERSECT
SELECT molecule_id
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        WHEN label = '-' THEN 'Non-carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c 
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.molecule_id
ORDER BY num_atoms DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOC = 65          -- SOC 65 = Continuation School
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    sc.District,
    sc.StatusType,
    AVG(sa.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM satscores AS sa
JOIN schools AS sc 
    ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY sc.District, sc.StatusType
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.School) AS num_schools
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T1.City = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    s.sname,
    sc.CharterNum,
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS writing_rank
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

WITH consumption_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer (CZK payers only)
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        ym.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
lowest_per_segment AS (
    -- The least amount of consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS lowest_consumption
    FROM consumption_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_average AS (
    -- Annual average of the lowest-consumption customers:
    -- (their total consumption) / (number of such customers)
    SELECT
        l.Segment,
        SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM consumption_2013 t
    JOIN lowest_per_segment l
      ON t.Segment = l.Segment
     AND t.total_consumption = l.lowest_consumption
    GROUP BY l.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS "SME_minus_LAM",
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS "LAM_minus_KAM",
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS "KAM_minus_SME";

SELECT T.team_long_name

    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id

  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
        SELECT AVG(TA2.chanceCreationPassing)
        FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2

SELECT c.name

SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count

SELECT P.player_name

SELECT PA.preferred_foot

SELECT

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes PA

WHERE PA.overall_rating = 77

ORDER BY P.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p

WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'

SELECT PA.defensive_work_rate

SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating

WHERE T2.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'

SELECT player_name

    FROM Player

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p

     ON p.player_api_id IN (
         m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,  m.home_player_4,
         m.home_player_5,  m.home_player_6,  m.home_player_7,  m.home_player_8,
         m.home_player_9,  m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
         m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,  m.away_player_4,
         m.away_player_5,  m.away_player_6,  m.away_player_7,  m.away_player_8,
         m.away_player_9,  m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
     )
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id

SELECT DISTINCT
       P.player_name,
       C.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P
      ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
JOIN Match AS M
      ON P.player_api_id IN (

SELECT C.name
FROM Country C
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT country_id, player_api_id
    FROM (
        SELECT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match

        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T

    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

    WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Italy')
),
italy_player_ids AS (
    SELECT home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM italy_matches

    UNION SELECT home_player_5  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_6  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_7  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_8  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_9  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_1  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_2  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_3  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_4  FROM italy_matches

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN stamina > 80 AND strength > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage

SELECT COUNT(*) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);

SELECT 
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        ELSE '1996'
    END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
