SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT
    disp.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - district.A11 AS gap
FROM client
JOIN disp     ON disp.client_id     = client.client_id
JOIN district ON district.district_id = client.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY
    client.birth_date ASC,     -- oldest first (earlier birth_date = older)
    district.A11 ASC           -- then lowest average salary

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND l.status = 'A'

  AND l.amount = (
        SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
        FROM loan AS l2
        JOIN account AS a2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id
        WHERE l2.duration > 12
          AND l2.status = 'A'
          AND STRFTIME('%Y', a2.date) = '1993'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN trans AS T2 
    ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.date < '1997-01-01'

SELECT account.date AS account_open_date
FROM trans

WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS biggest_transaction_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1996';

SELECT DISTINCT
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency
FROM account AS a
JOIN disp     AS d  ON d.account_id  = a.account_id
JOIN client   AS c  ON c.client_id   = d.client_id

SELECT a.account_id, a.date

WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')   -- active/running contracts (OK so far or in debt)

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients

WHERE client.gender = 'M'

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE 
            WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1

FROM card;

SELECT card.type

WHERE disp.client_id = 13539;

SELECT district.A3 AS region

WHERE client.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END)

JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   -
   SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
  ) * 100.0
  / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan AS l
JOIN disp   AS d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) IN ('1996', '1997');

  (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia')

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', client.birth_date) AS birth_year

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts

SELECT

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone

SELECT CONCAT(m.first_name, ' ', m.last_name) AS full_name,
       ma.college

SELECT

SELECT z.city

SELECT s.full_name

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_superheroes

SELECT

ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC;

SELECT COUNT(s.id) AS num_superheroes

SELECT s.superhero_name

SELECT
    -- Percentage of superheroes whose alignment is 'Bad'
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
        / COUNT(s.id),
        2
    ) AS percentage_bad,
    -- Number of 'Bad' superheroes published by Marvel Comics
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS marvel_bad_count
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id

SELECT c.colour

SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg) AS average_weight

SELECT s.superhero_name

SELECT s.superhero_name

SELECT s.full_name

SELECT sp.power_name

SELECT s.full_name

SELECT COUNT(id) * 1.0 / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) AS avg_no_skin_colour
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race

SELECT superhero.height_cm

SELECT s.full_name

SELECT

SELECT c.colour

SELECT p.publisher_name

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name

JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id

SELECT ha.attribute_value

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height

SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
            THEN 'More in-patients'
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
            THEN 'More outpatients'
        ELSE 'Equal'
    END AS comparison,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
            SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_pct
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT 
    Patient.ID, 
    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT 
    T2.Date AS lab_date,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_first_visit
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    /
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS age_at_test
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4'
  AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Examination.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms, COUNT(Symptoms) AS symptom_count
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY symptom_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_of_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND P.Admission = '-';

SELECT JULIANDAY(Examination.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(Patient.`First Date`) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes, within normal range'
        ELSE 'No, not within normal range'
    END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.Date,
    L.TP,
    L.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    T1.SEX, 
    T1.Birthday, 
    T1.Description, 
    T1.`First Date`, 
    T1.Admission, 
    T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID,
       l.ALB,
       CASE 
           WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' 
           ELSE 'No' 
       END AS Albumin_Normal_Range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) = 1982;

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS LatestDate
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) T ON L.ID = T.ID AND L.Date = T.LatestDate
WHERE (L.UA < 8.0 AND P.SEX = 'M')
   OR (L.UA < 6.5 AND P.SEX = 'F');

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    T1.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY T1.SEX;

SELECT P.ID AS Patient_ID,
       L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` > 0 
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 
  AND T2.IGG < 2000 
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.ID)
FROM Patient AS t1
JOIN Laboratory AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID
WHERE t2.CRP = '+' AND t1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 
    / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT Birthday
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GOT >= 60
)
ORDER BY Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
ORDER BY L.LDH DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(E.ANA) AS highest_ANA_level
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
GROUP BY T1.ID
HAVING MAX(T3."aCL IgA") = (
    SELECT MAX(T4."aCL IgA")
    FROM Examination AS T4
    JOIN Laboratory AS T5 ON T4.ID = T5.ID
    WHERE T5.CRE < 1.5
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS chlorine_molecule_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT bond.molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2

),
max_double_bonds AS (
    -- Find molecule(s) with the highest double bond count
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM double_bond_counts
    WHERE num_double_bonds = (SELECT MAX(num_double_bonds) FROM double_bond_counts)
)

  -- SME annual average minus LAM annual average
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS diff_SME_LAM,

  -- LAM annual average minus KAM annual average
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS diff_LAM_KAM,

  -- KAM annual average minus SME annual average
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS diff_KAM_SME;

FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.IGG > 900
  AND T1.IGG < 2000
  AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE Description IS NULL 
  AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE CRP = '+');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T3.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.RF < 20 
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T2.C4 > 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.SM IN ('negative', '0') 
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT t1.ID 
FROM Examination t1 
JOIN Laboratory t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID 
WHERE t1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' 
  AND t2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') 
    AND T1.SEX = 'F' 
    AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.GOT >= 60;
SELECT T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60 ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`) FROM Patient AS T1 WHERE T1.ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500 ORDER BY LDH DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT Date 
FROM Laboratory 
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 
ORDER BY ALB DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T2.ANA)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 
ORDER BY T3.`aCL IgA` DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.TG < 200 
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(a.atom_id)
FROM atom AS a
INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '=';

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T3.label = '-'

SELECT a.element
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR000'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') 
     - (SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '-') AS difference;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T2.bond_type, T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(bond_id) AS double_bond_count
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id;

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND bond.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
GROUP BY T2.element, T3.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.bond_id) AS proportion
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.element)
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = '-';

SELECT label
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
   OR molecule_id = 'TR001'
   OR molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
    OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'));

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 
FROM connected AS T1 
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id 
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T2.label = '-';

SELECT T1.bond_id, T2.label
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = '#'

SELECT element, COUNT(element)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE label = '+' AND substr(atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY element

SELECT T2.label 
FROM atom AS T1 
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T1.element = 'ca'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047'

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id 
FROM bond b 
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id 
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' 
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.atom_id 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE atom.element = 'c' 
  AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(bond_id) AS double_bond_count, 
       molecule.label 
FROM bond 
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR006' 
  AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T4.bond_type)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T4 ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T2.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) 
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM atom 
    WHERE element = 's'
)
AND molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM bond 
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
);

SELECT T1.label
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'cl' AND T2.label = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id 
FROM atom AS T1 
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id 
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id 
WHERE T1.element = 's' AND T3.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 'o' AND T3.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE label = '-' 
  AND molecule_id IN (
      SELECT molecule_id 
      FROM bond 
      WHERE bond_type = '#'
  );

SELECT 
    T1.`School Name`,
    T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Eligible Free Rate (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY `Eligible Free Rate (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T2.sname
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T1.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sc.District
FROM schools AS sc
JOIN satscores AS st ON sc.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY sc.District
ORDER BY AVG(st.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T2.cds)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    s.sname,
    sc.CharterNum,
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS writing_rank
FROM satscores AS s
INNER JOIN schools AS sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT 
    s.sname, 
    sc.FundingType
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.sname, sc.FundingType
HAVING SUM(s.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(s.cds) > 400;

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    s.Street, 
    s.City, 
    s.State, 
    s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`High Grade` = 12
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm f2
      JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey'
  AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr) AS avg_test_takers
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Fresno'
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.School, T1.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.DOC = 31
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT schools.School, schools.MailStreet
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores T1 
JOIN schools T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T2.MailCity = 'Lakeport' 
  AND T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrWrite >= 1500;

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T1.Charter = 0
  AND T2.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' 
  AND County = 'Stanislaus' 
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31';

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND ClosedDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1989-12-31'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.GSoffered = 'K-9';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.City,
    f.`Low Grade`
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(schools.CDSCode),
       COUNT(schools.City),
       schools.City
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.Magnet = 1
  AND schools.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY schools.City;

SELECT 
    T2.`District Code`,
    T2.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine';

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010'
  AND SOC = 62
  AND DOC = 54
  AND AdmEmail1 != ' '
  AND AdmEmail2 != ' '
  AND AdmEmail3 != ' ';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT p.AnswerCount
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
ORDER BY p.AnswerCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT users.DisplayName
FROM users
JOIN posts ON users.Id = posts.OwnerUserId
WHERE posts.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON tags.ExcerptPostId = posts.Id
WHERE tags.TagName = 'bayesian';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM badges 
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id 
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' 
  AND strftime('%Y', badges.Date) = '2011';

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT COUNT(c.Id) AS CommentCount
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount = 1910;

SELECT c.Text
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829 AND p.CommentCount = 1;

SELECT users.DisplayName
FROM comments
JOIN users ON comments.UserId = users.Id
WHERE comments.Text = 'thank you user93!';

SELECT users.DisplayName
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.LastEditorUserId = users.Id
WHERE posts.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data';

SELECT SUM(v.BountyAmount) AS TotalBountyAmount
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data%';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.BountyAmount = 50
  AND p.Title LIKE '%variance%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.Id) AS user_count
FROM users u
JOIN badges b1 ON b1.UserId = u.Id AND b1.Name = 'Teacher'
JOIN badges b2 ON b2.UserId = u.Id AND b2.Name = 'Supporter'
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%New York%';

SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.UserId = u.Id
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName, u.Views
HAVING COUNT(ph.Id) = COUNT(DISTINCT ph.PostId)
   AND u.Views >= 1000;

SELECT u.Id,
       u.DisplayName,
       b.Name AS BadgeName
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Id IN (
        SELECT c.UserId
        FROM comments c
        GROUP BY c.UserId
        HAVING COUNT(c.Id) = (
            SELECT MAX(cnt)
            FROM (
                SELECT COUNT(Id) AS cnt
                FROM comments
                GROUP BY UserId
            ) AS counts
        )
);

SELECT 
    ph.PostHistoryTypeId,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserId) 
     FROM comments c 
     WHERE c.PostId = 3720) AS UniqueCommenters
FROM postHistory ph
WHERE ph.PostId = 3720;

SELECT p.Score, pl.LinkTypeId
FROM posts p
JOIN postLinks pl ON p.Id = pl.PostId
WHERE p.Id = 395;

SELECT SUM(T2.UpVotes) / COUNT(T1.OwnerUserId) AS avg_up_votes,
       SUM(T2.Age) / COUNT(T1.OwnerUserId) AS avg_age
FROM posts AS T1
JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
GROUP BY T1.OwnerUserId
HAVING COUNT(T1.OwnerUserId) > 10;

SELECT badges.Date
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.Location = 'Rochester, NY';

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.CreaionDate = '2010-07-19 19:37:33.0';

SELECT DISTINCT u.Age
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE u.Location = 'Vienna, Austria';

SELECT badges.Name
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'Sharpie';

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 /
    COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011' THEN 1 END) AS vote_ratio
FROM votes;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- All 2013 consumption records of CZK-paying customers, with their segment
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    INNER JOIN customers AS c
            ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest consumption value within each segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    -- Customers that hit the lowest consumption in their segment
    SELECT DISTINCT a.Segment,
                    a.CustomerID
    FROM czk_2013 AS a
    INNER JOIN min_per_segment AS m
            ON m.Segment = a.Segment
           AND a.Consumption = m.min_consumption
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption per year / number of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM (
        SELECT a.Segment,
               a.CustomerID,
               SUM(a.Consumption) AS total_consumption
        FROM czk_2013 AS a
        INNER JOIN lowest_customers AS lc
                ON lc.Segment = a.Segment
               AND lc.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
        GROUP BY a.Segment, a.CustomerID
    ) AS z
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

),
appearances AS (

    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_2,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_3,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_4,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_5,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_6,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_7,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_8,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_9,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_10, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_11, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_1,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_2,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_3,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_4,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_5,  country_id FROM Match

    d.A11        AS lowest_average_salary,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap

SELECT
    100.0 *
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
    / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate

        SELECT d.account_id
        FROM disp d
        JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id

       CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) AS INTEGER)
         - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
INNER JOIN Laboratory l
    ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination
  ) * 1.2;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms 
FROM Examination 
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
GROUP BY Symptoms 
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet disease'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT 
    JULIANDAY(MIN(E.`Examination Date`)) - JULIANDAY(P.`First Date`) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.ID = 821298;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS Is_ALP_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT T1.ID, T2.TP, T2.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.TP > 8.5;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT
    P.ID,
    L.Date AS Lab_Date,
    L.ALB,
    CASE
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS ALB_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982'
ORDER BY P.ID, L.Date;

SELECT AVG(t.UA)
FROM (
    SELECT l.ID, l.UA
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(l2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory l2
        WHERE l2.ID = l.ID
    )
) t
JOIN Patient p ON t.ID = p.ID
WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND t.UA < 8.0)
   OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND t.UA < 6.5);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS result
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT T1.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY T1.SEX;

SELECT 
    L.ID, 
    L.`T-CHO`
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE 0 < T2.`U-PRO`
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(T2.CRE AS REAL) >= 1.5
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-') 
    AND T2.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory  ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Examination.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Thrombosis = 0
  AND T2.SM IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.DNA < 8 
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 
    / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(T1."First Date")
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH < 500
GROUP BY T1.ID
ORDER BY MAX(T2.LDH) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T3.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.TG < 200 
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT
  ( SELECT COUNT(*)                                -- = SUM(bond_type = '-')
    FROM bond AS b
    JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'                            -- carcinogenic molecules
      AND b.bond_type = '-'                        -- single bonds
  ) * 1.0
  /
  ( SELECT COUNT(*)                                -- = COUNT(atom_id)
    FROM atom AS a
    JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'                            -- carcinogenic molecules
  ) AS average
;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '=';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a 
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.bond_type
FROM bond AS T1
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY T1.bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (
    SELECT atom_id FROM connected
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected
);

SELECT a1.atom_id, a1.element, a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'pb';

SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(T1.bond_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected) AS percentage
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id  = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
GROUP BY T2.element, T3.element
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id),
    5
) AS proportion
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT label
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' 
   OR molecule_id = 'TR001' 
   OR molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT CASE
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 THEN 'yes'
         ELSE 'no'
       END AS has_both_cl_and_c
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.bond_type = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id, 
       m.label,
       CASE 
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' 
           WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic' 
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(a.element) AS element_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151' 
  AND label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT T2.molecule_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
  AND T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND bond.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY molecule.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS num_chlorine_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM atom 
        WHERE element = 's'
    ) 
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM bond 
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    );

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT molecule_id
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_2'
INTERSECT
SELECT molecule_id
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 's'
  AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(atom_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(T4.atom_id) AS atom_count
        FROM molecule AS T3
        JOIN atom AS T4 ON T3.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id
        WHERE T3.label = '+'
        GROUP BY T3.molecule_id
    ) AS subquery
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 'o' AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT 
    frpm.`School Name`,
    frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Eligible Free Rate (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools 
    ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode

LIMIT 3;

SELECT satscores.sname 
FROM satscores 
INNER JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr > 500 
  AND schools.Magnet = 1

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CDSCode
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T1.dname
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT

    T2.CharterNum
FROM satscores T1
INNER JOIN schools T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode

  AND T1.AvgScrWrite > 499;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING SUM(t.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(s.CDSCode) > 400;

SELECT T1.`School Name`,
       T2.Street,
       T2.City,
       T2.State,
       T2.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2
  ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode

);

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` 
FROM frpm 
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount                            AS loan_amount,
    l.payments                          AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration,
    l.status,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' 
                       AND t.k_symbol = 'UVER' 
                      THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)      AS total_paid,
    l.amount - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' 
                                  AND t.k_symbol = 'UVER' 
                                 THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS remaining_debt
FROM client c
JOIN disp  d ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN loan  l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992
GROUP BY 
    l.loan_id, l.amount, l.payments, l.duration, l.status, l.date;

    ROUND(
        COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 /
        NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END), 0),
        2

    p.ID,
    p.Birthday,
    l.Date,
    l.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN CAST(l.ALB AS REAL) BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Outside normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID

SELECT AVG(t.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM (
    SELECT p.SEX,
           l.UA,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.ID ORDER BY l.Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
) t
WHERE t.rn = 1
  AND ((t.SEX = 'M' AND t.UA < 8.0)
    OR (t.SEX = 'F' AND t.UA < 6.5));

SELECT bond_type

ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(bond.bond_type = '-') / COUNT(connected.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(element = 'c') / COUNT(atom_id) AS percentage

JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '=';

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b      ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1     ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2     ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'                     -- single bond
  AND m.label = '-'                         -- not carcinogenic
  AND a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id        -- both connected atoms
  AND a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id        -- belong to this molecule
ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2

JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label

JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id

SELECT T1.label

WITH per_customer AS (
    -- Total consumption in 2013 for each CZK-paying customer
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y
      ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
segment_min AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption in each segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    -- Annual average consumption of the lowest-consumption customers:
    -- (total consumption per year) / (number of lowest-consumption customers)
    SELECT p.Segment,
           SUM(p.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg_consumption
    FROM per_customer p
    JOIN segment_min m
      ON p.Segment = m.Segment
     AND p.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg_consumption END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM segment_avg;

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
  * 100.0
  / SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan AS l
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.account_id = l.account_id
      AND c.gender = 'M'
  );

    SELECT UserId, NumComments
    FROM CommentCounts
    WHERE NumComments = (SELECT MAX(NumComments) FROM CommentCounts)
)

SELECT
    /* SME annual average - LAM annual average */
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'SME'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1)
  -
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'LAM'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1) AS diff_SME_LAM,

    /* LAM annual average - KAM annual average */
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'LAM'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1)
  -
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'KAM'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1) AS diff_LAM_KAM,

    /* KAM annual average - SME annual average */
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'KAM'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1)
  -
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'SME'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1) AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH match_players AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
)
SELECT c.name AS country
FROM Country c
JOIN match_players mp ON mp.country_id = c.id
JOIN Player p         ON p.player_api_id = mp.player_api_id
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING AVG(p.weight) = (
    SELECT MAX(avg_weight)
    FROM (
        SELECT AVG(p2.weight) AS avg_weight
        FROM Country c2
        JOIN match_players mp2 ON mp2.country_id = c2.id
        JOIN Player p2         ON p2.player_api_id = mp2.player_api_id
        GROUP BY c2.name
    ) t
);

JOIN account a    ON a.account_id = d.account_id

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     -
     SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
    ) * 100.0
    /
    SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE l.account_id IN (
        SELECT d.account_id
        FROM disp d
        JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
        WHERE c.gender = 'M'
      )
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS in_patient_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS outpatient_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) * 1.0 /
        COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT T1.ID,
       strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis

    FROM Laboratory

);

JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC, L.Date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_abnormal_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_abnormal_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID;
