FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;

SELECT 
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    l.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.TP,
    (l.TP - 8.5) AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT
    Patient.ID,
    Patient.SEX,
    Patient.Birthday,
    Patient.Description,
    Patient."First Date",
    Patient.Admission,
    Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.Date,
    l.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS Albumin_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T1.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(T3.Date)
        FROM Laboratory AS T3
        WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID
      )
  AND (
        (T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0)
        OR
        (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    Patient.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) AS Patient_List
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT  P.ID,
        L."T-CHO"
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
     ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO")
                   FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC   -- oldest = earliest birthday
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.APTT > 45
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.IGG > 900 
  AND l.IGG < 2000 
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_female_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory  ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.DNA < 8
  AND P.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Patient.ID END) * 1.0
       / COUNT(Patient.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) AS Youngest_Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
  AND L.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.ALB > 3.5
  AND Laboratory.ALB < 5.5
  AND Laboratory.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) AS highest_ANA
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T3.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG < 200
    ORDER BY TG DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
HAVING COUNT(bond_type) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(bond_type) AS cnt
        FROM bond
        GROUP BY bond_type
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS chlorine_molecule_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
       / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
JOIN bond      ON bond.bond_id      = connected.bond_id
JOIN molecule  ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b      ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(molecule_id), 
       3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'          -- not carcinogenic
  AND b.bond_type = '-'      -- single bond
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id, bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'Not carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) top_molecule 
    ON top_molecule.molecule_id = m.molecule_id;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id  FROM connected)
  AND a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,
       a1.element AS atom1_element,
       a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,
       a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b  ON c.bond_id  = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type  = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_double_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY num_double_bonds DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'pb';

WITH bond_elements AS (
    SELECT
        c.bond_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
),
combo_counts AS (
    SELECT element1, element2, COUNT(*) AS num_bonds
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY element1, element2
)
SELECT 100.0 * MAX(num_bonds) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM combo_counts;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
         / COUNT(b.bond_id),
         5
       ) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 THEN 'Yes'
         ELSE 'No'
       END AS has_chlorine_and_carbon
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY element;

SELECT m.label
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'Non-carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id 
    AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_chlorine_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT
    a.atom_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN bond b     ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM atom 
        WHERE element = 's'
      )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM bond 
        WHERE bond_type = '='
      );

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'c'
  AND T1.label = '-';

SELECT a1.molecule_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN atom a2 ON a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(atom_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(atom_id) AS atom_count
        FROM atom a2
        JOIN molecule m2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY a2.molecule_id
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o'
  AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_triple_bond_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT
    f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOCType = 'Continuation High School'
  AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T2.School
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND T2.Magnet = 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(st.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Merged' 
  AND T1.County = 'Alameda' 
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    T2.sname AS School_Name,
    T2.AvgScrWrite AS Average_Writing_Score,
    T1.CharterNum AS Charter_Number
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND T1.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T2.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
  AND t.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT s.School,
       s.Street,
       s.City,
       s.State,
       s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
     ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND f.`High Grade` = '12';

SELECT 
    T2.School, 
    T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
        SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
        FROM frpm AS T3
        INNER JOIN schools AS T4 
            ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
        WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT 
    `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS Eligible_Free_Rate_K12
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT schools.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS avg_test_takers
FROM schools sc
JOIN satscores s ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno'
  AND strftime('%Y', sc.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT s.AvgScrWrite, sc.City
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School,
       f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment_k12
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f
  ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` = (
        SELECT MAX(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`)
        FROM frpm f2
        JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
        WHERE s2.DOC = 31
      );

SELECT schools.School, schools.MailStreet
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite >= 1500
  AND sc.MailCity = 'Lakeport';

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Joaquin'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND Virtual = 'P';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_non_chartered_schools
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND schools.Charter = 0
  AND frpm.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' 
  AND CharterNum = '00D4';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded'
  AND County = 'Stanislaus'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31';

SELECT County, COUNT(CDSCode) AS num_closures
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY num_closures DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    T2.School,
    T1."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" / T1."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" * 100 AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1."County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.GSserved = 'K-9';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    schools.City,
    frpm.`Low Grade`,
    schools.School
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY schools.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.City,
    COUNT(f.CDSCode) AS Number_Of_Schools
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'

WITH customer_totals AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per CZK customer in each segment
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym 
        ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest consumption in each segment
    SELECT 
        Segment, 
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_averages AS (
    -- Annual average of the lowest-consuming customer(s) per segment:
    -- total consumption / number of customers with the lowest consumption
    SELECT 
        t.Segment,
        SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM customer_totals t
    JOIN min_per_segment m 
        ON t.Segment = m.Segment 
       AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_vs_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_vs_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_vs_SME;

    SELECT m.country_id, p.weight
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Player p
      ON p.player_api_id IN (
          m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,  m.home_player_4,
          m.home_player_5,  m.home_player_6,  m.home_player_7,  m.home_player_8,
          m.home_player_9,  m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
          m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,  m.away_player_4,
          m.away_player_5,  m.away_player_6,  m.away_player_7,  m.away_player_8,
          m.away_player_9,  m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
      )
) t ON t.country_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(t.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '97' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
   / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
  , 2) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) IN ('96', '97')

WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
           > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        THEN 'In-patient' 
        ELSE 'Outpatient' 
    END AS majority_group,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
        / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2
    ) AS deviation_in_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

SELECT T1.ID,
       (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) 
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT MAX(T2.Date) AS LabCompletionDate,
       (strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS AgeAtArrival
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
GROUP BY T1.ID
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT e.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND p.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND e.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GPT = 9 AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER) 
     - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.UA = '8.4'
  AND l.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27' 
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1
WHERE T1.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T1.ANA = 'S'
  AND T1.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(T2.`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination AS T2) * 1.2;

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' 
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet' 
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT JULIANDAY(T1.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(T2.`First Date`)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ID = 821298;

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m-%d', p.Birthday) = '1982-04-01';

SELECT L.ID, L.TP - 8.5 AS deviation_of_TP_from_normal
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT P.*
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    Patient.ID,
    Patient.Birthday,
    Laboratory.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN Laboratory.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Not within normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE substr(Patient.Birthday, 1, 4) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T3.UA)
FROM (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS LatestDate
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T3
    ON T3.ID = T1.ID AND T3.Date = T1.LatestDate
JOIN Patient AS T2
    ON T2.ID = T3.ID
WHERE (T2.SEX = 'M' AND T3.UA < 8.0)
   OR (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T3.UA < 6.5);

SELECT DISTINCT 
    p.ID, 
    p.SEX, 
    p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND l.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS more_male_than_female
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT
    p.SEX,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT P.ID AS patient_id, L.`T-CHO` AS t_cho_index
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.APTT > 45 
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (L.FG < 150 OR L.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.IGG > 900
  AND T1.IGG < 2000
  AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
    - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND T3.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.DNA < 8
  AND T2.Description IS NULL;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.GOT >= 60;

SELECT P.Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(T2.`First Date`)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500)

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T2.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%'

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
HAVING COUNT(bond_type) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(bond_type) AS cnt
        FROM bond
        GROUP BY bond_type
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
        / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM molecule
JOIN bond      ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN atom      ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(atom.element = 'c') * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT bond.molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T3.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' 
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT a.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE 
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
           ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'yes' 
         ELSE 'no' 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a1.element AS atom1_element, 
       a2.element AS atom2_element,
       a1.atom_id AS atom1_id, 
       a2.atom_id AS atom2_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '='
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.atom_id2
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb';

WITH bond_elements AS (
    -- Get the element pair for each bond
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           a1.element AS element1,
           a2.element AS element2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
),
combo_counts AS (
    -- Count how many bonds share each element combination
    SELECT element1, element2, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY element1, element2
)
SELECT 100.0 * bc.cnt / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM combo_counts bc
WHERE bc.cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM combo_counts);

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(b.bond_id), 
        5
    ) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element IN ('cl', 'c') THEN a.element END) = 2
         THEN 'yes'
         ELSE 'no'
       END AS has_both_chlorine_and_carbon
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8';

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id, m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) 
FROM atom a 
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE m.label = '+' AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' 
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T4 ON T2.atom_id2 = T4.atom_id
WHERE T3.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND T4.atom_id = 'TR000_2';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
       m.label          AS carcinogenic_label
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b 
       ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS num_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE element = 's'
      )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = '='
      );

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl'
  AND T1.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
INTERSECT
SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) 
FROM bond b 
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE frpm.`Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation Education'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T1.sname
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND T2.Magnet = 1;

SELECT T1.Phone
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
ORDER BY T2.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.dname
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T1.dname
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
  AND s.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND t.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    T1.sname,
    T2.CharterNum,
    T1.AvgScrWrite,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS ranking
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
  AND T1.AvgScrWrite > 499
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING SUM(t.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(t.cds) > 400;

SELECT schools.School,
       schools.Street,
       schools.City,
       schools.State,
       schools.Zip
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
  AND frpm.`Low Grade` = '9'
  AND frpm.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
        SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
        FROM frpm AS f2
        JOIN schools AS s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
        WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
      );

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, restricted to customers paying in CZK
    SELECT ym.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND CAST(ym.Date AS TEXT) BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
segment_min AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption within each segment (SME / LAM / KAM)
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    -- Annual average of the lowest-consumption customer(s) per segment
    -- = their total consumption / number of such customers
    SELECT cz.Segment,
           SUM(cz.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 cz
    JOIN segment_min sm
      ON cz.Segment = sm.Segment
     AND cz.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cz.Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM segment_avg;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);

SELECT
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        ELSE '1996'
    END AS higher_percentage_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp   ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) 
                      FROM client 
                      WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district);

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.duration > 12
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1993'
ORDER BY T2.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT T1.date
FROM account AS T1
JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.amount = 840
  AND T2.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d    ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN trans t   ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1996';

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d     ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c   ON c.client_id  = d.client_id
JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'                        -- the account holder (owner)
  AND dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'                  -- client's region is East Bohemia
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3 AS district,
       SUM(l.amount) AS total_active_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')   -- 'C' = running contract OK, 'D' = running contract, client in debt
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY total_active_loans DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A16 = (SELECT MAX(A16) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_gold_owner_cards
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha';

SELECT SUM(CASE 
             WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 
             ELSE 0 
           END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct_gold_cards_before_1998
FROM card;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541;

SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_women
FROM disp d
JOIN account  a  ON a.account_id  = d.account_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN client   c  ON c.client_id   = d.client_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END),
    2
  ) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM disp d
        JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
        WHERE d.account_id = l.account_id
          AND c.gender = 'M'
      )
  AND strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT
    (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia')
    -
    (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS crime_difference;

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', client.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS birth_year
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.account_id = 130
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount   AS debt_amount,
    l.payments AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration,
    l.status
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 992;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid_1998
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 617
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Beroun' 
  AND account.date > '1996-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(l.account_id) AS num_loan_accounts
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration = 24
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_students
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.college = 'College of Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM attendance
JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT DISTINCT m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
ORDER BY COUNT(a.link_to_member) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(e.event_id) AS num_events
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'
  AND strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2019';

SELECT COUNT(T1.event_id) AS num_meetings
FROM (
    SELECT event.event_id
    FROM event
    JOIN attendance ON event.event_id = attendance.link_to_event
    WHERE event.type = 'Meeting'
    GROUP BY event.event_id
    HAVING COUNT(attendance.link_to_member) > 10
) AS T1;

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type != 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(e.event_id) > 20;

SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_name) AS average_attendance
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
  AND strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2020';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud';

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent_on_food
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'September Meeting'
  AND b.category = 'Food';

SELECT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.position = 'President';

SELECT notes

WHERE source = 'Fundraising'
  AND date_received = '2019-09-14';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS exceeded_budget_count
FROM budget
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = 'November Meeting'
  AND budget.remaining < 0;

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget_amount
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'September Speaker';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS medium_tshirt_count
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business'

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.source = 'Dues'
ORDER BY T2.date_received ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.category = 'Parking' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / SUM(b.amount) AS percentage
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'November Speaker';

SELECT z.city, z.county, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Amy' AND m.last_name = 'Firth';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_maryland_members
FROM member
JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
WHERE zip_code.state = 'Maryland';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS meeting_count
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Meeting'
  AND strftime('%Y', event_date) = '2020';

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN budget b  ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev  ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id

SELECT t_shirt_size
FROM member

ORDER BY COUNT(t_shirt_size) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event

ORDER BY b.remaining ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT

JOIN event e 
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker'

SELECT budget_id, category, amount

                FROM budget
                WHERE category = 'Food');

SELECT major.major_name

SELECT m.position
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE ma.major_name = 'Business';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business' 
  AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT m.major_name
FROM member mem
JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
WHERE mem.position = 'Vice President';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_majors
FROM major
WHERE college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences'
  AND department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education';

SELECT DISTINCT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE mj.department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department'

SELECT DISTINCT m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE m.position = 'Member'
  AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Game'
  AND status = 'Closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT 
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    e.event_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense x 
    ON m.member_id = x.link_to_member
JOIN attendance a 
    ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN event e 
    ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event

FROM expense
JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_members
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'Education'
  AND major.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
  AND member.position = 'Member';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY MAX(e.cost) DESC

FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e
    ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member

SELECT superhero.height_cm

SELECT s.full_name

SELECT c.colour

INNER JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN 'in-patient'
        ELSE 'outpatient'
    END AS more_common,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
        / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT
    P.ID,
    strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

FROM Patient

    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.UA = '8.4'

SELECT p.Diagnosis AS original_diagnosis
FROM Patient p

  AND e.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT DISTINCT p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND l.CRP > 2
  AND l.CRE = 1

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(P.SEX) AS percentage_women
FROM Patient P
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1980'
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'

SELECT julianday(E.`Examination Date`) - julianday(P.`First Date`) AS days_to_evaluation
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.ID = 821298;

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    CASE 
        WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS ALP_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT P.*
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
  ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday,
    L.ALB,
    CASE
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS ALB_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS average_UA
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory L2
        WHERE L2.ID = L.ID
      )
  AND (
        (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
     OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, SEX, Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT p.ID, l.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 
  AND T2.IGG < 2000 
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+'
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
INNER JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Examination.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.C4 > 10 
  AND Patient.ID IN (
      SELECT ID 
      FROM Examination 
      WHERE Thrombosis = '2'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.DNA < 8
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0
     / COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 THEN Laboratory.ID END) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID;

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P.ID = (
    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L.LDH < 500
    ORDER BY L.LDH DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.ALB > 3.5
  AND L.ALB < 5.5
  AND L.TP >= 6.0
  AND L.TP <= 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT L.ID
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5
  AND E.`aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L."T-BIL" >= 2.0
  AND E."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS num_molecules
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '='

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'        -- not carcinogenic
  AND b.bond_type = '-'    -- single bond
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    a.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'Not carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T3.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'pb'

UNION

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T3.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
WHERE T3.element = 'pb';

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected)
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
         CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0
         / COUNT(b.bond_id),
       5) AS carcinogenic_single_bond_proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) AS num_elements
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN EXISTS (
             SELECT 1
             FROM connected AS cn
             JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = cn.atom_id
             JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = cn.atom_id2
             WHERE cn.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
               AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
                 OR (a1.element = 'c'  AND a2.element = 'cl'))
         )
         THEN 'yes'
         ELSE 'no'
       END AS has_both_cl_and_c;

SELECT T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE m.label
           WHEN '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
           WHEN '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(a.element) AS element_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'Non-Carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes, molecule TR151 is carcinogenic' 
         ELSE 'No, molecule TR151 is not carcinogenic' 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_atoms
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'yes (carcinogenic)' 
        ELSE 'no (non-carcinogenic)' 
    END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id 
    AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id, 
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS number_of_bond_types
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a 
    ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM atom 
    WHERE element = 's'
) 
AND molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM bond 
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
);

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl'
  AND T1.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'Non-carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(atom.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
   AND a.element = 'o'
JOIN connected c 
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id 
    OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
   AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_triple_bond_molecules
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS EligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY EligibleFreeRate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T1.sname
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    sc.District,
    AVG(st.AvgScrRead) AS avg_reading_score
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools sc 
    ON st.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY sc.District
ORDER BY avg_reading_score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.cname = 'Alameda (merged)'

SELECT 
    s.sname AS School_Name,
    sch.CharterNum,
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS Writing_Rank
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch 
    ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s

SELECT c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption

JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY TotalConsumption ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  -- Difference: SME - LAM
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Segment = 'SME'
                             AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Segment = 'LAM'
                             AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  AS diff_SME_LAM,

  -- Difference: LAM - KAM
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Segment = 'LAM'
                             AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Segment = 'KAM'
                             AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  AS diff_LAM_KAM,

  -- Difference: KAM - SME
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Segment = 'KAM'
                             AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Segment = 'SME'
                             AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  AS diff_KAM_SME;

    FROM (
        SELECT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match

        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
    ) AS mp
    JOIN Player AS p
        ON p.player_api_id = mp.player_api_id
    GROUP BY mp.country_id
) AS t

    ON c.id = t.country_id

JOIN attendance AS T2

SELECT notes

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget_amount

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT z.city, z.county, z.state
