WHERE m.first_name = 'Amy' AND m.last_name = 'Firth';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS maryland_members
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE z.state = 'Maryland';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM event 
WHERE type = 'Meeting' 
  AND strftime('%Y', event_date) = '2020';

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense ex ON ex.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b   ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget

SELECT

FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id;

SELECT t_shirt_size

LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.event_name

WHERE T1.status = 'Closed' AND T2.remaining < 0
GROUP BY T1.event_name
ORDER BY MIN(T2.remaining) ASC

SELECT b.category, SUM(b.amount) AS amount_budgeted
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker'
GROUP BY b.category
ORDER BY amount_budgeted ASC;

SELECT budget_id
FROM budget
WHERE category = 'Food'

SELECT m.major_name
FROM member mem
JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
WHERE mem.first_name = 'Phillip'
  AND mem.last_name = 'Cullen';

SELECT m.position
FROM member m

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business' 
  AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT m.major_name

JOIN member AS mem ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_majors

SELECT DISTINCT zip.city, zip.state

SELECT DISTINCT m.last_name
FROM member m

JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE m.position = 'Member'
  AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Game'
  AND status = 'Closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT DISTINCT

    M.first_name,
    M.last_name,
    A.link_to_event,
    E.event_name
FROM member AS M
JOIN attendance AS A

WHERE X.approved = 'true'

SELECT DISTINCT member.email
FROM expense
JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE expense.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
  AND expense.cost > 20;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_members
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.position = 'Member'
  AND major.major_name = 'education'
  AND major.college = 'College of Education & Human Services';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT 
    SUM(ex.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense AS ex
JOIN member AS m 
    ON ex.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget AS b 
    ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name

FROM member AS T1

WHERE T2.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

SELECT major.major_name, major.department

JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id

  AND member.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone

JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id

SELECT 
    member.first_name,

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent

JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

SELECT T2.city
FROM member AS T1

  AND T1.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_superheroes

SELECT

    s.height_cm

SELECT COUNT(*)

    COUNT(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 END) AS marvel_bad_count

JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour

SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg) AS average_weight

JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id

SELECT s.superhero_name

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s

SELECT s.full_name

WHERE hero_power.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(superhero.id) / SUM(superhero.skin_colour_id = 1) AS average
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c2.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)

FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg)

    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg)

     WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS weight_difference;

SELECT AVG(height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT p.publisher_name

JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero

JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT 
    SUM(gender.id = 2) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm)
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT superhero.id) AS num_fastest_superheroes
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT superhero.full_name
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.weight_kg < 100
  AND colour.colour = 'brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT s.power_name
FROM superhero sh
JOIN hero_power hp ON sh.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower s ON hp.power_id = s.id
WHERE sh.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100.0 / COUNT(ID) AS percentage_inpatient
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940';

SELECT T1.ID, year(current_timestamp) - year(T1.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T2.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) 
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200;

SELECT MIN(L.`Date`)                                                AS lab_date,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER)
         - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)              AS age_at_first_arrival
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
     ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE UPPER(P.Diagnosis) = 'SJS'                 -- SJS patient
  AND P.Birthday = (SELECT MIN(Birthday)         -- oldest = smallest birthday
                    FROM Patient
                    WHERE UPPER(Diagnosis) = 'SJS');

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    /
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P
    ON L.ID = P.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT strftime('%Y', L.Date) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UA = '8.4'
  AND L.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(ID), ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Examination.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND Examination.Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';

SELECT JULIANDAY(T2.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(T1.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = 821298;

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE 
           WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' 
           ELSE 'No' 
       END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    T2.Date, 
    T2.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' 
  AND T2.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Out of normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory AS T
JOIN Patient AS P
    ON T.ID = P.ID
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) AS Latest
    ON T.ID = Latest.ID
   AND T.Date = Latest.latest_date
WHERE (P.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0)
   OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    P.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS Patient_List
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (
    SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`)
    FROM Laboratory
)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `U-PRO` >= 30
);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID)
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGG > 900

SELECT
  -- SME annual average minus LAM annual average
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS diff_SME_LAM,

  -- LAM annual average minus KAM annual average
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS diff_LAM_KAM,

  -- KAM annual average minus SME annual average
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, restricted to CZK-paying customers
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest consumption in each segment (SME / LAM / KAM)
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consumption customer(s)
    --                 / number of customers at that lowest level
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 t
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment
     AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM annual_avg;

WITH italian_matches AS (
    SELECT M.home_player_1,  M.home_player_2,  M.home_player_3,  M.home_player_4,
           M.home_player_5,  M.home_player_6,  M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,
           M.home_player_9,  M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
           M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,
           M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,
           M.away_player_9,  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
    FROM Match M
    JOIN Country C ON C.id = M.country_id
    WHERE C.name = 'Italy'
),
italy_player_ids AS (
    SELECT home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_2  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_3  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_4  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_5  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_6  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_7  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_8  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_9  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_1  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_2  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_3  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_4  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_5  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_6  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_7  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_8  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_9  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM italian_matches
)
SELECT AVG(DISTINCT P.height) AS average_height
FROM Player P
JOIN italy_player_ids I
  ON P.player_api_id = I.player_api_id;

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (
        SELECT account_id 
        FROM loan
  );

SELECT 
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        ELSE '1996'
    END AS year_with_higher_unemployment
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp     ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  -- oldest female client(s): earliest birth date (smaller birth_date = older)
  AND c.birth_date = (
        SELECT MIN(birth_date)
        FROM client
        WHERE gender = 'F'
      )
  -- among those oldest females, keep only the district with the lowest average salary
  AND d.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(A11)
        FROM district
        WHERE district_id IN (
              SELECT district_id
              FROM client
              WHERE gender = 'F'
                AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                                  FROM client
                                  WHERE gender = 'F')
        )
      );

SELECT DISTINCT l.account_id

SELECT

SELECT

    l.loan_id,
    l.amount          AS loan_amount,
    l.payments        AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration        AS duration_months,
    l.date            AS loan_date,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Contract finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Contract finished - loan NOT paid (debt)'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Running - payments OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Running - client in DEBT'
    END AS payment_status

JOIN loan  l ON d.account_id  = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

SELECT c.colour AS hair_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'human';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(id) / SUM(CASE WHEN skin_colour_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c2.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
    * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female_marvel
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) 
     FROM superhero 
     WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') 
    - 
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) 
     FROM superhero 
     WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS difference;

SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT 
    a.alignment,
    sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a 
    ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp 
    ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp 
    ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes_count
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Brown'
  AND s.weight_kg < 100;

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral';

SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power AS hp
JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (
    SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8
    FROM superhero
);

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS inpatient_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS outpatient_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 /
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) 
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200;

SELECT L.Date,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) -
       CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_first_arrival
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
     ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l
    ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' 
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT SUBSTR(L.Date, 1, 4) - SUBSTR(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS age
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.UA = '8.4'
  AND L.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT p.Diagnosis AS Original_Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND e.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2
  AND E.ANA = 'S'
  AND E.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory  AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND P.Admission = '-';

SELECT CAST(julianday(`Examination Date`) - julianday(`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS days_until_first_evaluation
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT T1.ID,
       T2.ALP,
       CASE
           WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes'
           ELSE 'No'
       END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.TP,
    l.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes - within normal range'
        ELSE 'No - outside normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory L2
        WHERE L2.ID = L.ID
      )
  AND (
        (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
     OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        > SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND E.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SM IN ('negative', '0')
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(Patient.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.DNA < 8 
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
             THEN Patient.ID END) * 1.0 
  / 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 
             THEN Patient.ID END) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID;

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.`First Date`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH < 500
ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.ALB > 3.5
  AND L.ALB < 5.5
  AND L.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) AS highest_ANA_level
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.CRE < 1.5
  AND T2.`aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(bond_type = '-') / COUNT(atom_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b       ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c  ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1      ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2      ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m
  ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY b.bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id, 
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'Non-carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id  FROM connected)
  AND a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY num_double_bonds DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN atom pb     ON pb.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE pb.element = 'pb'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom pb     ON pb.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE pb.element = 'pb';

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected) AS percentage
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
        / COUNT(b.bond_id), 
        5
    ) AS carcinogenic_percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
);

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 'cl' END) = 1
          AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'c'  THEN 'c'  END) = 1
         THEN 'yes' 
         ELSE 'no' 
       END AS answer
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a 
  ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    m.label,
    CASE m.label
        WHEN '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        WHEN '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(element)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT 
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id, a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label AS carcinogenic_label,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS chlorine_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE element = 's'
    )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    );

SELECT molecule.label

WITH yearly AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer (CZK only), with their segment
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           y.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption value within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    -- The customer(s) with the least consumption in each segment
    SELECT yr.Segment,
           SUM(yr.total_consumption) AS total_consumption,
           COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM yearly AS yr
    JOIN min_per_segment AS m
      ON yr.Segment = m.Segment
     AND yr.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY yr.Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption per year / number of lowest customers
    SELECT Segment,
           total_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest_customers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WHERE e.approved = 'true'
  AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT DISTINCT member.email
FROM expense
JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE expense.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
  AND expense.cost > 20;

SELECT COUNT(m.member_id) AS num_members
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'education'
  AND mj.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(expense.cost) / COUNT(event.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense
JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id
JOIN budget ON expense.link_to_budget = budget.budget_id
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE member.position != 'Member';

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 
    ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
GROUP BY T1.member_id
ORDER BY MAX(T2.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

SELECT major.major_name, major.department
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Garrett' AND member.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, mj.college
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT T1.city
FROM zip_code AS T1
JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.zip_code = T2.zip
WHERE T2.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T2.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
GROUP BY s.id, s.full_name
HAVING COUNT(hp.power_id) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(T1.id)
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT 
    s.superhero_name,
    s.height_cm,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC;

SELECT COUNT(s.id) AS num_superheroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';

SELECT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MIN(hero_attribute.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute
      JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
      WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  );

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(s.id) AS REAL) AS bad_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_comics_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg) 
FROM superhero AS T1 
JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id 
WHERE T2.gender = 'Female';

SELECT T1.superhero_name 
FROM superhero AS T1 
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id 
WHERE T2.race = 'Alien'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN race AS r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour AS c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'Human';

SELECT T2.power_name
FROM hero_power AS T1
JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.hero_id = 1;

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(superhero.id) / SUM(superhero.skin_colour_id = 1)
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT T1.height_cm
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT eye_colour.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour AS skin_colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = skin_colour.id
JOIN colour AS eye_colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = eye_colour.id
WHERE skin_colour.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent_female
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT alignment.alignment, superpower.power_name
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT DISTINCT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
WHERE hero_attribute.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) * 100.0 AS percentage
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
INNER JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE alignment.id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id 
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' 
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) 
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' 
  AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND LOWER(c.colour) = 'brown';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_male_inpatients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_male_outpatients,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(SUBSTR(T1.Birthday, 1, 4)) - MIN(SUBSTR(T1.Birthday, 1, 4)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200;

SELECT 
    L.Date,
    (STRFTIME('%Y', P.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday)) AS Age_At_First_Visit
FROM Laboratory AS L
INNER JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) AS INTEGER) 
     - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.UA = '8.4'
  AND Laboratory.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Thrombosis` = 2
  AND T2.`ANA` = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 0.2;

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;
SELECT MAX(Symptoms) FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT CAST(SUM(SEX = 'F') AS REAL) / COUNT(SEX) * 100 AS percentage_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
INNER JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID 
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' 
  AND Examination.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' 
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'Behcet disease' 
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';

SELECT JULIANDAY("Examination Date") - JULIANDAY("First Date") AS days_elapsed
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Examination.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT p.ID, l.ALP,
       CASE WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT T2.TP - 8.5
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.TP > 8.5;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday, L.ALB
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.Date,
    l.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Not within normal range'
    END AS ALB_Status
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date = (
    SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
    FROM Laboratory L2
    WHERE L2.ID = L.ID
)
AND (
    (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
    OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5)
);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT Patient.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS Patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.IGG > 900
  AND T1.IGG < 2000
  AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T3.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2 AND T3.C4 > 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') 
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F' 
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(T2.Birthday) 
FROM Patient AS T2 
JOIN Laboratory AS T1 
ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(`First Date`) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID 
    FROM Laboratory 
    WHERE LDH < 500 
    ORDER BY LDH DESC 
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT e.ID
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Laboratory AS l
    ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE < 1.5
  AND e.`aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.TG < 200 
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) 
FROM molecule AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
       / COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM molecule
JOIN bond
  ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-';

SELECT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element
LIMIT 3;

SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') 
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(molecule_id), 
       3) AS percentage
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT bond.bond_type, connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id, 
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'Not carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       (m.label = '+') AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT c.atom_id 
                        FROM connected c)
  AND a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT c.atom_id2 
                        FROM connected c);

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1_id, a1.element AS atom1_element,
       a2.atom_id AS atom2_id, a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_double_bonds
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'          -- carcinogenic molecules only
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '    -- count only double bonds
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY num_double_bonds DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS percentage
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.element)
FROM atom AS T1

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- All monthly consumption records for 2013 of customers paying in CZK
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
),
seg_min AS (
    -- Lowest consumption value per segment for 2013
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    -- Customers with the least consumption in each segment
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.Consumption) AS total_consumption,
           COUNT(z.CustomerID) AS num_customers
    FROM czk_2013 AS z
    JOIN seg_min AS m
      ON z.Segment = m.Segment
     AND z.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
),
avg_consumption AS (
    -- Annual average consumption = total consumption per year / number of lowest-consuming customers
    SELECT Segment,
           total_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_customers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;
