JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
JOIN products AS T3 ON T2.ProductID = T3.ProductID
WHERE substr(T1.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
  AND substr(T1.Date, 5, 2) = '09';

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM gasstations AS g
JOIN transactions_1k AS t
    ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE strftime('%Y%m', t.Date) = '201306';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CustomerID)
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND T2.Consumption > 1000;

SELECT CustomerID
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
GROUP BY CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Country
FROM gasstations
WHERE GasStationID = (
    SELECT GasStationID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
    ORDER BY Time ASC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
ORDER BY t.Date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Country
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '12:42:00';

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers AS c
JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date LIKE '%201306%'
  AND y.Consumption = 214582.17;

SELECT T2.Country
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Price = 548.4
  AND T1.Date = '2012-08-24';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM customers AS T1
WHERE T1.CustomerID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT T2.CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k AS T2
    WHERE T2.Date = '2012-08-25'
);

SELECT 
    SUM(Price) AS total_amount_spent,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Date = '201201' THEN Price ELSE 0 END) AS amount_spent_jan_2012
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE CustomerID = 38508;

SELECT 
    t.CustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS average_price_per_item,
    c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
ORDER BY overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_name, height
FROM Player
ORDER BY height DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes
ORDER BY potential ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MAX(crossing) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND M.home_team_goal < M.away_team_goal
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating = (
      SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50
  AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT AVG(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
        AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT SUM(T1.long_shots) / COUNT(T1.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_long_shots
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T1.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 
    ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND T2.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND T2.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND T2.chanceCreationPassing < (
        SELECT AVG(chanceCreationPassing)
        FROM Team_Attributes
        WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
          AND date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
          AND date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY T2.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

SELECT PA.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';

SELECT T2.heading_accuracy
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Francois Affolter'
  AND T2.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND M.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE player_api_id = (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    ORDER BY birthday DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT L.name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Country AS C ON L.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Netherlands';

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS avg_home_team_goal
FROM Match AS m
INNER JOIN Country AS c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Poland'
  AND m.season = '2010/2011';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating > 80
  AND strftime('%Y', PA.date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT TA.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_short_name = 'CLB';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayPassing > 70;

SELECT c.name AS country_name
FROM League l
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE l.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT COUNT(M.id) AS total_matches
FROM Match AS M
INNER JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', M.date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';

SELECT Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.overall_rating
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes 
    ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player_Attributes.overall_rating = (
    SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes
);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(PA.crossing) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND SUBSTR(M.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04';

SELECT T1.name
FROM League AS T1
INNER JOIN Match AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.league_id
WHERE T2.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY T1.name
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(T2.overall_rating) / COUNT(T2.id) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.birthday) < '1986';

SELECT T2.preferred_foot
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo';

SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) 
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id 
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = 77
  AND PA.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY P.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2
  ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND T2.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT T2.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
  AND T2.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT AVG(T2.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
    AND SUBSTR(T2.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT T2.player_name
FROM (
    SELECT player_name,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS rank_height
    FROM Player
) AS T2
WHERE T2.rank_height = 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m 
  ON p.player_api_id IN (
      m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
      m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
      m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
      m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
      m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
      m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
  )
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT 
    p.player_name, 
    c.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p 
    ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
JOIN Match m 
    ON pa.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10,
        m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
        m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9,
        m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country c 
    ON c.id = m.country_id
WHERE pa.vision > 89;

SELECT C.name
FROM Country C
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT M.country_id, P.player_api_id, P.weight
    FROM Match M
    JOIN Player P
      ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1,  M.home_player_2,  M.home_player_3,
                             M.home_player_4,  M.home_player_5,  M.home_player_6,
                             M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,  M.home_player_9,
                             M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
                             M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,
                             M.away_player_4,  M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,
                             M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,  M.away_player_9,
                             M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
) T ON T.country_id = C.id
GROUP BY C.name
ORDER BY AVG(T.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT AVG(T1.height)
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Match AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.home_player_1
JOIN Country AS T3 ON T2.country_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.name = 'Italy';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
INNER JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND l.status = 'C';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' 
         ELSE '1996' 
       END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
      - (SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
         FROM client c2
         JOIN disp dp2   ON c2.client_id = dp2.client_id
         JOIN account a2 ON dp2.account_id = a2.account_id
         JOIN district d2 ON a2.district_id = d2.district_id
         WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
           AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) 
                                FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
        ) AS salary_gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp    dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a  ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) 
                      FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN disp dp2    ON c2.client_id = dp2.client_id
        JOIN account a2  ON dp2.account_id = a2.account_id
        JOIN district d2 ON a2.district_id = d2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
          AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) 
                               FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  );

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2
  ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.duration > 12
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1993'
ORDER BY T2.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1996';

SELECT DISTINCT
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency
FROM account a
INNER JOIN disp d     ON a.account_id = d.account_id
INNER JOIN client c   ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
INNER JOIN district t ON c.district_id = t.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND t.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3 AS district_name
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    district_id AS branch_location, 
    A2 AS district_name
FROM district
WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A16 = (SELECT MAX(A16) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND account.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_high_level_owner_cards
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT o.account_id
FROM `order` o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client c 
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id 
WHERE c.gender = 'M' 
  AND d.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha';

SELECT c.type
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
WHERE cl.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) 
       / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) AS INT) = 1997 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) AS INT) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
     * 100.0
     / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) AS INT) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d  ON d.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) AS INT) IN (1996, 1997);

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia') 
    - 
    (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS crime_difference;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT 
    loan.loan_id,
    loan.amount AS debt_amount,
    loan.payments,
    loan.duration,
    loan.status
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN loan ON disp.account_id = loan.account_id
WHERE client.client_id = 992
  AND loan.status = 'D';

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 617
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1998%';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun'
  AND a.date > '1996-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_account_count
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration = 24
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_students
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.college = 'College of Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT attendance.link_to_member) AS num_students
FROM attendance
JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT m.phone
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
ORDER BY COUNT(a.link_to_event) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha' 
  AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'
  AND strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2019';

SELECT COUNT(T1.event_id)
FROM event AS T1
WHERE T1.type = 'Meeting'
  AND T1.event_id IN (
      SELECT T2.link_to_event
      FROM attendance AS T2
      GROUP BY T2.link_to_event
      HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_member) > 10
  );

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type != 'fundraiser'
GROUP BY e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(e.event_id) > 20;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_name) AS average_attendance
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
  AND strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2020';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud';

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_food_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'September Meeting'
  AND b.category = 'Food';

SELECT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code

WITH element_pairs AS (
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           a1.element AS elem1,
           a2.element AS elem2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
),
combo_counts AS (
    SELECT elem1, elem2, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM element_pairs
    GROUP BY elem1, elem2
),
top_combo AS (
    SELECT elem1, elem2, cnt
    FROM combo_counts
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
         top_combo.cnt * 100.0 /
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond),
       2) AS percentage
FROM top_combo;

WITH customer_totals AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer (only CZK-paying customers)
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym 
        ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
segment_min AS (
    -- Minimum total consumption within each segment
    SELECT 
        Segment, 
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    -- Customers whose consumption equals the segment's minimum
    SELECT 
        ct.Segment, 
        ct.total_consumption
    FROM customer_totals ct
    JOIN segment_min sm 
        ON  ct.Segment = sm.Segment
        AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
),
averages AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption / number of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT 
        Segment, 
        SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_average
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH oldest_female_clients AS (
    -- Step 1: female clients with the earliest birth_date (= oldest)
    SELECT client_id, district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date = (
            SELECT MIN(birth_date)
            FROM client
            WHERE gender = 'F'
      )
),
lowest_salary AS (
    -- Step 2: among those oldest females, the lowest average salary (A11) of their districts
    SELECT MIN(d.A11) AS min_salary
    FROM oldest_female_clients c
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
)
-- Step 3: their account numbers + gap vs. the highest average salary overall
SELECT
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT min_salary FROM lowest_salary) AS gap
FROM oldest_female_clients c
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp dp    ON dp.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN account a  ON a.account_id  = dp.account_id
WHERE d.A11 = (SELECT min_salary FROM lowest_salary);

JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', account.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996;

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d 
    ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account AS a

JOIN district AS dt 
    ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND substr(a.date, 1, 2) IN ('95', '96', '97', '98', '99', '00')

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id

FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')

SELECT

SELECT COUNT(account_id) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account
WHERE district_id = (

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.status = 'A';
AND account.district_id = 1;        -- branch location 1

WHERE c.gender = 'M'

      SELECT MAX(A15)
      FROM district
      WHERE A15 < (SELECT MAX(A15) FROM district)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_gold_owner_cards
FROM card

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT trans.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM trans

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients_praha
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha'

SELECT 
    100.0 * SUM(CASE 
                    WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' 
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0 
                END) / COUNT(*) AS percent_gold_before_1998
FROM card;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE disp.client_id = 13539;

SELECT district.A3 AS region
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d 
    ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a 
    ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di 
    ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
       - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
        * 100.0
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0),
        2
    ) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) IN ('1996', '1997')
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM disp d
        JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
        WHERE d.account_id = l.account_id
          AND c.gender = 'M'
  );

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE d.account_id = 130
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.date                          AS loan_date,
    l.amount                        AS loan_amount,
    l.payments                      AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration,
    l.status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'finished - loan NOT paid'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'running - OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'running - client in DEBT'
    END                             AS payment_status,
    CASE
        WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 0
        WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount
        ELSE MAX(0,
             l.amount - l.payments *
             CAST((julianday('1999-01-01') - julianday(l.date)) / 30.44 AS INTEGER))
    END                             AS remaining_debt
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d  ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
WHERE c.client_id = 617
  AND t.type = 'withdrawal'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(t.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 1998;

SELECT
    -- Which group is larger among male patients
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            THEN 'in-patient'
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           < SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            THEN 'outpatient'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS more_common,
    -- Deviation in percentage: (male in-patients / male outpatients) * 100
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
    2) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis

    FROM Laboratory

SELECT
    L.Date AS lab_completion_date,
    CAST(SUBSTR(P.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(SUBSTR(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS age_when_first_arrived

SELECT p.Diagnosis

SELECT Symptoms

SELECT

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

WITH bond_elements AS (
    -- One row per bond: the (unordered) pair of elements of its two atoms
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.bond_id,
        CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element ELSE a2.element END AS elem_lo,
        CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a2.element ELSE a1.element END AS elem_hi
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
),
combo_counts AS (
    -- Count how many bonds have each element combination
    SELECT elem_lo, elem_hi, COUNT(*) AS bond_cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY elem_lo, elem_hi
)
-- Hint: DIVIDE( count of bonds in the MAX group , total number of bonds )
SELECT 100.0 * MAX(bond_cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS pct_most_common_combo
FROM combo_counts;

WITH czk_consumption AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, limited to CZK-paying customers
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_average AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consumption customers
    --                 / number of those customers
    SELECT cc.Segment,
           SUM(cc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(cc.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_consumption cc
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON cc.Segment = m.Segment
     AND cc.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'human';

SELECT T1.power_name
FROM superpower AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.power_id
WHERE T2.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(id) / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) AS average
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT s.height_cm
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c2.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT superhero.full_name
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE race.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent_female
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky')
    -
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS difference;

SELECT superhero_name,
       SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero
GROUP BY superhero_name;
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT alignment.alignment, superpower.power_name
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
JOIN hero_power ON hero_power.hero_id = superhero.id
JOIN superpower ON superpower.id = hero_power.power_id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT SUM(gender.id = 2) * 100.0 / COUNT(alignment.id) AS percentage_female_bad_superheroes
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
INNER JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT hero_attribute.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN attribute ON attribute.id = hero_attribute.attribute_id
JOIN superhero ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND superhero.superhero_name = 'Hulk';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id 
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_inpatient_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_outpatient_count,
  ROUND(
    1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 4
  ) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_inpatient
FROM Patient
WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

SELECT T1.ID, (strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) 
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT T1.Date,
       strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age_At_Admission
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.Date = '1992-06-12' AND T2.GPT = '9';

SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4'
  AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(ID) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE SEX = 'F' 
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' 
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T1.Admission = '-' 
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' 
  AND T2.Diagnosis = "BEHCET'S DISEASE";

SELECT JULIANDAY(`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(`First Date`) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT P.ID, L.ALP < 300
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT L.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5

SELECT * 
FROM Patient 
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' 
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5) 
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT P.ID,
       L.ALB,
       CASE 
           WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' 
           ELSE 'No' 
       END AS `Albumin within normal range`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS average_UA
FROM (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS LatestDate
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) AS Latest
JOIN Laboratory L 
    ON L.ID = Latest.ID AND L.Date = Latest.LatestDate
JOIN Patient P 
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
   OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND T2.UN < 30;

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
        FROM Patient 
        JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
        WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5) 
     > 
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
        FROM Patient 
        JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
        WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5) AS answer;

SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_ids
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT L.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC, L.`T-CHO` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (l.FG < 150 OR l.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
  AND T2.`U-PRO` > 0 
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+'
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T3.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T3.C4 > 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SM IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN Examination.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 
  / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(T2.Birthday) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500);

SELECT Date 
FROM Laboratory 
WHERE ALB = (
    SELECT MAX(ALB) 
    FROM Laboratory 
    WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
)
AND ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T1.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%'

SELECT Diagnosis 
FROM Patient 
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID 
    FROM Laboratory 
    WHERE TG < 200 
    ORDER BY TG DESC 
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c 
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT T1.element, T2.element
FROM connected AS T3
JOIN atom AS T1 ON T3.atom_id = T1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T3.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T4 ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T4.bond_type = '#' AND T4.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_double_bonds
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'          -- carcinogenic molecules only
  AND b.bond_type = '='      -- double bonds only
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY num_double_bonds DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(T1.bond_id) / (SELECT COUNT(bond_id) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id  = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE (T2.element, T3.element) = (
        SELECT T4.element, T5.element
        FROM connected AS T6
        JOIN atom AS T4 ON T6.atom_id  = T4.atom_id
        JOIN atom AS T5 ON T6.atom_id2 = T5.atom_id
        GROUP BY T4.element, T5.element
        ORDER BY COUNT(T6.bond_id) DESC
        LIMIT 1
      );

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(b.bond_id), 
       5) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.element)
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'

SELECT COUNT(element)
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND element = 'cl'

INTERSECT

SELECT COUNT(element)
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND element = 'c';

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) 
FROM bond b 
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id, m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(atom.element) AS element_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND SUBSTR(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'ca';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-'

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label AS carcinogenic_label,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id 
   AND b.bond_type = '='
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE element = 's'
    )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = '='
    );

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'c'
  AND T1.label = '-';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE c.atom_id  = 'TR000_2'
  AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

WITH annual_consumption AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM annual_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT a.Segment, SUM(a.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.CustomerID) AS annual_average
    FROM annual_consumption a
    JOIN segment_min m ON m.Segment = a.Segment AND m.min_consumption = a.total_consumption
    GROUP BY a.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

WITH seg AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         SUM(y.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID) AS annual_avg_consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND SUBSTR(CAST(y.Date AS TEXT), 1, 4) = '2013'
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM seg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
    - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
  (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
    - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
    - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) -
       (SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
        FROM district d2
        JOIN client c2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
          AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')) AS gap

JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND di.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
                FROM district d2
                JOIN client c2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS seg, y.CustomerID AS cid, y.Consumption AS cons
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
segmin AS (
    SELECT seg, MIN(cons) AS minc
    FROM czk
    GROUP BY seg
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT z.seg, z.cid
    FROM czk AS z
    JOIN segmin AS m ON m.seg = z.seg AND m.minc = z.cons
),
annual AS (
    SELECT seg, cid, SUM(cons) AS total
    FROM czk
    GROUP BY seg, cid
),
avgc AS (
    SELECT l.seg AS seg, SUM(a.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS av
    FROM lowest AS l
    JOIN annual AS a ON a.seg = l.seg AND a.cid = l.cid
    GROUP BY l.seg
)
SELECT
    (SELECT av FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'SME') - (SELECT av FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT av FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'LAM') - (SELECT av FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT av FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'KAM') - (SELECT av FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH czk_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_by_segment AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_totals ct
    JOIN min_totals mt
      ON mt.Segment = ct.Segment
     AND mt.min_consumption = ct.total_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'in-patient' ELSE 'outpatient' END AS more, (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M'
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS age FROM Patient JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Examination.RVVT = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.ALB < 3.5
SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG >= 200)

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2 FROM connected c JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#'

SELECT molecule.label FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'ca'

SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151'

SELECT frpm."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType LIKE '%Continuation%'
  AND frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1
SELECT schools.Phone FROM schools JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT "CDSCode" FROM frpm WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" + "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500

SELECT schools.District
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY schools.District
ORDER BY AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T2.County = 'Alameda' AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100
SELECT schools.CharterNum FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT T1.sname, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.cname = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T1.sname
HAVING SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(T1.sname) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Monterey'
  AND f."High Grade" = '12'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800;

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE LOWER(s.FundingType) = 'locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm f2
      JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE LOWER(s2.FundingType) = 'locally funded'

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND CAST(y.Date AS TEXT) LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment, CustomerID, total_consumption
    FROM (
        SELECT Segment, CustomerID, total_consumption,
               MIN(total_consumption) OVER (PARTITION BY Segment) AS min_c
        FROM czk
    ) t
    WHERE total_consumption = min_c
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WHERE LOWER(colour.colour) = 'blue' AND LOWER(gender.gender) = 'male';
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(gender_id = 2) / COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE c.colour = 'Green' AND a.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id) FROM hero_attribute JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE attribute_name = 'Speed' AND attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien'

SELECT DISTINCT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100 AND LOWER(c.colour) = 'brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm)
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';
SELECT hp.hero_id FROM hero_power AS hp JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';
SELECT ID, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS age FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE RVVT = '+')
SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5
SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTR(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient AS P WHERE P.ID IN (SELECT L.ID FROM Laboratory AS L WHERE L.TG >= 200)

SELECT MAX(L.Date), strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
GROUP BY P.ID
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;
SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
SELECT T2.`aCL IgM` FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'
SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'

SELECT p."Diagnosis"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p."ID" = e."ID"
WHERE e."Examination Date" = '1997-01-27' AND e."Diagnosis" = 'SLE';
SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+' ORDER BY ID
SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2 AND T2.ANA = 'S' AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2
SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS' AND T3.CRP > 2 AND T3.CRE = 1 AND T3.LDH = 123
SELECT T1.Symptoms FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' GROUP BY T1.Symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Symptoms) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'Behcet' AND Patient.Admission = '-' AND Examination."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997';

SELECT JULIANDAY(MIN(e."Examination Date")) - JULIANDAY(p."First Date") AS days
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT t1.ID, t2.ALP < 300 AS "ALP within normal range"
FROM Patient AS t1
JOIN Laboratory AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m-%d', t1.Birthday) = '1982-04-01'
SELECT TP - 8.5 FROM Laboratory WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F') AND TP > 8.5
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC

SELECT p.ID, CASE WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Albumin within normal range"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(l.UA) AS average_UA
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date = (SELECT MAX(l2.Date) FROM Laboratory l2 WHERE l2.ID = l.ID)
  AND ((p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5 AND P.SEX = 'M') > (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5 AND P.SEX = 'F') THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END;
SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L."T-CHO"
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.APTT > 45 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450)
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0 AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.IGG > 900 AND T3.IGG < 2000 AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 60;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T2.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-') AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8 AND Patient.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`) FROM Patient AS T1 WHERE T1.ID = (SELECT T2.ID FROM Laboratory AS T2 WHERE T2.LDH < 500 ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
  AND T1."aCL IgA" = (
      SELECT MAX(T3."aCL IgA")
      FROM Examination AS T3
      INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T4 ON T3.ID = T4.ID
      WHERE T4.CRE < 1.5
  );
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2."T-BIL" >= 2.0 AND T3."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%'
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR004_8_9' UNION SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR004_8_9')

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') FROM molecule;
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;
SELECT bond_type FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_type LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE TRIM(b.bond_type) = '='
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected UNION SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT a1.element AS atom1, a2.element AS atom2
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label LIKE '%+%'
  AND bond.bond_type LIKE '%=%'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.atom_id2 AS atom_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT c.atom_id AS atom_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) FROM connected) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
);

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) FROM atom JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002')

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
      AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
           OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'))
) THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END;

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id, m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';
SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' GROUP BY atom.element
SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'ca'
SELECT CAST(SUM(bond_type = ' = ') AS REAL) / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';
SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+');
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT T1.atom_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id)
FROM connected
WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'cl')
   OR atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'cl');

SELECT a.atom_id, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id) AS bond_type_count
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR346'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_4'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id OR T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 's' AND TRIM(T3.bond_type) = '=';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ' AND b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Eligible Free Rate`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY `Eligible Free Rate` ASC
LIMIT 3;
